title: An inbound SCIM client deleted or deactivated a resource (OP-155 m.3 (g))
description: The member of the SET `events` claim, and of the CloudEvent `data.events`, under `urn:suiss:access:event:scim.deprovisioned`. The account is soft-deleted with a tombstone and its id is never reused (INV-32, OP-73). A notification, never an authority source.

scim_client.description: The inbound SCIM client's opaque id.

resource.description: The resource's opaque id Access assigned; never a userName, an email address or an externalId.

access_position.description: The event's monotone version field (OP-22): it only grows within its source, the domain for an authority event and the issuer for an identity event. A receiver that has applied a later or equal position re-queries instead of applying this event.
